sections.title: Controls
sections.intro:
Text fields draw themselves; the other controls are abstract and need a skin.
These cards use plain skins like the ones that [Give your controls a look](/use/learn/going-further/ui-kit/) writes.

sections.title: Text effects, markup and modifiers
sections.intro:
Text effects move or color each glyph: JOID ships the `ITextEffect` interface, and the effects and the markup of these cards are written like the ones in [Text markup and effects](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text-markup-and-effects/).
Text modifiers change the characters before layout.

sections.title: Cursors
sections.intro:
The cursor shapes a node asks for with `cursor(...)`; the operating system draws them, so their look follows the system, and each card shows a plain drawing of the shape.
[Hover, tooltips and cursors](/use/learn/interactivity/hover-and-tooltips/#change-the-cursor-over-a-node) shows how a node asks for one.
